name: Decoys and chaff
description: Combat change, a sub-option of BVR combat (add-on picker, Work in progress; on by default there). It also works without BVR combat. Ships with a countermeasures (ECM) component carry a few decoy charges (3 by default; 1 more for each further ECM component, up to 2 more). When missiles or torpedoes (the BVR launchers' and the stock ones) are inbound on such a ship, it launches a decoy: every missile in flight at it has a chance (50%) to be pulled off target (torpedoes half as often). A ship can launch one decoy every few seconds, so a big salvo is a cat-and-mouse game: the defender wants decoys left for the second wave and the attacker wants to stagger its volleys. Decoys are reloaded at your own or an ally's space ports and bases with a dock, or from a deployed resupply ship, for a small price in credits. It works with or without BVR combat. AI empires put at least one countermeasures component on every warship design, and one more when their enemies field missiles. The ship panel shows 'Decoys 2/3'.
